title: Top Gulf official offers glimmer of hope on Trump-Iran nuclear talks as threat of war hangs over region
summary: A senior United Arab Emirates official says he is cautiously optimistic about U.S.-Iran nuclear talks through Qatari mediation but won't rule out war.

title: Trump highlights NASA nuclear-powered Mars spacecraft mission planned for 2028
summary: President Donald Trump announced NASA will launch its first nuclear-powered spacecraft to Mars within two years, aiming to send astronauts to the red planet.

title: Bernie Sanders thinks Medicare-for-all bill could pass, 'not absolutely certain' Trump would veto
summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., said he's not certain President Donald Trump would veto Medicare-for-all legislation, arguing the president is "a good politician."

title: White House trashes 'peanut-sized brain' Jimmy Kimmel after host demands Trump 'resign'
summary: The White House fired back at Jimmy Kimmel after the ABC late-night host called on President Donald Trump to resign, with spokesman Davis Ingle saying his brain has "rotted."

title: Trump's move from Wiles to Miller signals major tactical shift for governing without Congress
summary: Stephen Miller and Russ Vought have been identifying policies Trump can enact by executive order on immigration, tariffs and government spending.

title: Trump names Stephen Miller new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
summary: Susie Wiles served 21 months as Trump's longest-serving chief of staff across both terms, departing after Republicans lost the House and Senate. Trump announced Stephen Miller will take on the role.

title: Progressive group's 182-page blueprint maps out potential Dem investigations into Trump, corporate allies
summary: Former President Joe Biden aides mapped Tesla, Apple, Amazon and OpenAI as targets for sweeping Democratic congressional investigations into Trump allies.

title: Americans who 'screw up' their eating should use a simple fix, says Stanford scientist
summary: Christopher Gardner of Stanford says legumes like lentils, tofu and edamame are an underutilized source of protein and fiber in healthy diets.

title: GOP eyes Senate comeback after Democratic bloodbath, but another political nightmare could await
summary: Democrats won at least 54 Senate seats Tuesday, but Republicans could flip the chamber in 2028 by sweeping six competitive states and holding the VP.

title: Meghan Markle's estrangement from father Thomas Markle: From royal wedding fallout to his arrest
summary: Thomas Markle Sr. was arrested in Florida on child pornography charges. Meghan Markle and her father have been estranged for years.
